info.name: Orbix School ERP API
info.description:
API collection for all Orbix custom Odoo 19 modules: bxi_api (auth, sessions, password), bxi_notification_gateway (OTP, OTP login, password reset), bxi_online_fee_payment and the full bxi_api_support surface - profile & master data, push devices and the notification inbox, fees, exemptions, refunds, scholarships, attendance (hr.attendance), homework, offline exams, digital assessments, library circulation, events, calendar, the teacher app (today, classes, leave, activity log), academic management, lesson plans, timetable admin, admissions and RTE, certificates, announcements & notices (filtered by audience), onboarding, canteen, uniform, transport, health, lab, visitors, dashboards, people and elective registration.

Auth: call 'Login' (or 'OTP Login') first - it saves the returned token into the {{token}} collection variable, used as a Bearer token on every other request via the collection-level Authorization. Update the id-like collection variables (student_id, exam_id, refund_id, ...) to point at real records in your database before running requests that use them. Binary endpoints (PDFs, photos) return the file, not the JSON envelope. Uploads accept multipart/form-data or JSON `attachments: [{name, data (base64), mimetype}]`.

item.name: Admin Dashboard (bxi_api_support)
item.description: Admin-dashboard lists and forms: classes and sections, fees across students (collection by class, defaulters, fee categories) and events (figures, create/edit, announcement, attendance). Each list returns items, meta (total/limit/offset) and a summary over every matching record.

request.description: Classes with section count, students, capacity, fill % and sections without a class teacher, plus a summary over every matching class. Filters: q, department_id, program_id, academic_year_id, active (1/0/all); expand=sections; sort=name|code|department [asc|desc]. Academic coordinators, back-office admins.
A class with every section (classroom, class teacher, strength, subject teachers from the timetable) and its subjects with their mapped teachers.
A section's current students by roll number with their parents' contact details.

Create a class and, optionally, its sections in one go (all or nothing). Section code is generated from the class code when left out; dates default to the current academic year. Back-office admins and academic managers.
Any create field except sections; "active": false archives the class.
Add a section to a class.
Any create field except class_id; "active": false archives the section.

Every student's fee lines with class/section, plus a summary (payable, collected, pending, overdue, count by status) over every matching line. Filters: student_id, course_id, batch_id, structure_id, category_id, academic_year_id, state (cancelled lines hidden by default), collection_status, overdue=1, due_from/due_to, q (student name or registration number); sort=due_date|student|total_payable|amount_paid|amount_pending|days_overdue|status [asc|desc]. Fee staff.
Students billed, payable, collected, pending, overdue and collection % per class (group_by=section for per section). Takes the List Fees filters.

One row per student with an overdue balance: amount, oldest due date, days overdue and parent contacts. min_days filters by lateness; takes the List Fees filters; sort=overdue_amount|days_overdue|oldest_due_date|student [asc|desc].
Fee categories with how many fee structures use each. active=1/0/all, q.
product_id is the product that carries the income account (see /masters/service-products).
Any create field; "active": false archives the category.

Every event with status, seats, registration counts, pending permission slips and payment figures, plus a summary. Filters: q, category, status (upcoming/ongoing/past/cancelled), date_from/date_to (UTC days), venue_id, course_id, batch_id, academic_year_id; sort=date_begin|name|category|venue [asc|desc]. Event coordinators.
Event categories, audiences, statuses and the default timezone for the event form.
An event with its figures and every registration (student, class, section, parent, slip, invoice, attended).
Dates are UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS). A paid event needs fee_product_id. Venue double-booking is refused.
